title: Making a rusty lake ripoff for halloween, added voice
author: Intelligent_Key2760
selftext:
Halloween’s coming so I made a rusty lake style thing. You’re stuck in a room, someone keeps knocking on the door every halloween and won’t leave, and eventually you realize a kid is owed a candy and you can’t get out until he has it.

The big difference from actual Rusty Lake is you can talk to one of the characters. Rusty Lake has great sound, and the characters say stuff, but you can’t talk back. I love paradise and seasons but I have to watch yt videos to figure out the relationships lol. So here the guy in the portrait talks back (mic or typing) and you can just ask him what happened that night. I mostly wanted it to drag you into the story. If he just tells you what to click next there’s no point playing.

Getting that balance right was way harder than the puzzles. My first version literally said “put the candle in the pumpkin” and it ruined the whole vibe. Then I made him super vague and got stuck in my own game. now he answers with memories first and only gets more direct if you keep asking

Astra did the rough first draft (gameplay, basic structure) and then I moved it to Opus 5.5, which is where all the ambient sound and the knocking came from. That’s what made it creepy instead of a webpage with a picture on it. kind of restored my faith in opus tbh !!!

It’s definitely not there yet but it’s been really fun to mess with and I want to keep pushing it. curious what you all think of talking to characters in a puzzle game like this.
